findings.fix: In TDD Anchor: (1) note that 'softDelete_userNotFound_throwsAppException' is a RENAME of 'softDelete_userNotFound_returnsError'; (2) note that 'logEvent_propagatesRepositoryError' is a RENAME+REWRITE of 'logEvent_fireAndForget_repositoryErrorDoesNotPropagate' — the old test asserted no propagation, the new test must assert propagation.
